Edexcel A-Level Maths Question Bank — Bingkun Qi

A question-bank project for Edexcel A-Level mathematics, bringing course practice resources into a dedicated teaching tool.

About this project

Moving from IGCSE to A-Level changes both the depth of mathematics and the practice students need. This project continues my exploration of organising teaching resources online, with a focus on Edexcel A-Level mathematics.

I see these projects as a connection between teaching and technology: identify a classroom need, then try to turn the idea into a usable tool.

Features and use cases

  • Focused on Edexcel A-Level mathematics
  • Organised around course questions and practice
